top.title: Court orders Maina’s son to serve seven-year jail term
top.description: …..Faisal to serve sentence concurrently from October 14 re-arrest A Federal High Court in Abuja has ordered the remand of Faisal Maina, son of former Chairman of the defunct Pension Reform Task Team, Abdulrasheed Maina, in a correctional centre to serve his seven-year jail term for money laundering. Justice James Omotosho made the order on Thursday after granting an ex parte application filed by the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC). The commission had asked the court to issue a warrant committing Faisal to the Nigeria Correctional Service (NCoS) to enforce the judgment convicting him of money laundering and failure to make full disclosure in an asset declaration form. Faisal was arrested by the Department of State Services (DSS) on October 14 in the Karsana area of Abuja, about six years after he jumped bail and absconded from trial. He was subsequently handed over to the EFCC. In its application, the commission also sought an order directing that his prison sentence should commence from October 14, the date of his re-arrest. After the EFCC’s lawyer, M.K. Hussain, moved the application, Justice Omotosho granted the reliefs sought and issued a warrant for Faisal’s commitment to a correctional centre. The judge ordered that, in line with the Court of Appeal’s judgment of November 24, 2022, Faisal should serve three years’ imprisonment on count one, seven years on count two and three years on count three. The sentences are to run concurrently, beginning from October 14, 2026, when he was re-arrested. Faisal was arraigned before the Federal High Court in Abuja in 2019 on a three-count charge bordering on money laundering and failure to fully disclose his assets. He pleaded not guilty to the charges before Justice Okon Abang, who was then presiding over the case, but later jumped bail and stopped attending court proceedings. Following his disappearance, Abang proceeded with the trial in his absence and convicted him on October 7, 2021. The court initially sentenced him to five years’ imprisonment on counts one and three, and 14 years on count two, with the sentences to run concurrently. Abang also ordered that Faisal be arrested wherever he was found and taken to a correctional centre to serve his sentence. However, the Court of Appeal subsequently upheld the conviction but reduced the sentences in its judgment delivered on November 24, 2022, to three years on counts one and three, and seven years on count two. Faisal’s father, Abdulrasheed, was also convicted in a separate money laundering case involving about N2 billion. He has since completed his prison term. top.title: BOA earmarks N200bn for 400,000 dry-season farmers
top.description: …..FMN targets five tonnes of wheat per hectare in 2026/2027 farming season By Muhammad Inuwa, Dutse The Bank of Agriculture (BOA) has earmarked about N200 billion to finance dry-season agricultural activities for 400,000 farmers across Nigeria as part of efforts to boost domestic food production and strengthen food security. The North-West Zonal Manager of the bank, Abdul-Razaq Datti Saleh, disclosed this at the flag-off of the 2026/2027 dry-season wheat farming programme organised in partnership with Flour Mills of Nigeria (FMN) at Maje Village, Taura Local Government Area of Jigawa State. Saleh explained that the financing would be channelled through farmer aggregator companies to enable individual farmers to access support for land preparation, irrigation, improved seeds, fertilisers and other essential agricultural inputs. He said the partnership with FMN was aimed at increasing domestic wheat production, reducing Nigeria’s dependence on imported wheat and strengthening food security. According to him, wheat remains an important raw material for households and industries, adding that expanding local production would create employment opportunities, increase farmers’ incomes and strengthen rural economies. Also speaking, the General Manager of Golden Agro Input Limited (GAIL), a subsidiary of FMN Agro, Engineer Tayo Ilori, said the company was supporting 10,000 farmers across six states under the 2026 dry-season wheat programme. He explained that each participating farmer received agricultural inputs for one hectare, comprising 100 kilogrammes of wheat seeds, six bags of urea, four bags of NPK 20:10:5 fertiliser and chemicals for weed and pest control. Ilori estimated the value of the input package at between N250,000 and N350,000 per hectare. He said the inputs were provided as loans, which farmers would repay with harvested wheat grains at prevailing market prices rather than through cash payments. Ilori identified improved seeds, quality fertilisers and regular extension services as critical factors in increasing wheat productivity. He added that GAIL had deployed about 250 lead outgrowers to provide technical guidance and support to participating farmers across the six states. The company, he said, was targeting a yield of seven metric tonnes per hectare in the 2026/2027 season, expressing confidence that the target was achievable through the adoption of modern farming practices. The Project Director, Engineer Olusegun Falade, said the programme had raised average wheat productivity from less than one tonne per hectare at its inception to about 4.2 tonnes, with some farmers recording yields of up to 7.2 tonnes. Falade identified farmers’ reluctance to repay loans, slow adoption of improved farming practices and land ownership challenges as some of the obstacles confronting the programme. top.title: Police investigation into Vigar's death ongoing
top.description: Billy Vigar died from a "significant brain injury" in September 2025 [Getty Images] The police investigation into the death of former Arsenal academy player Billy Vigar is ongoing, a coroner's court has heard. Vigar died from a "significant brain injury" in September 2025, five days after colliding with a concrete wall surrounding a pitch while playing for Chichester City at Wingate and Finchley's stadium. His parents, Keith and Camilla, told BBC Sport on the one-year anniversary that "the FA could have stopped Billy losing his life because they had so many warnings". Det Supt Colin Chandler, from the Metropolitan Police, told a pre-inquest review hearing that he anticipated he would need another "two to three months" on his investigation. He did not provide details on the lines of enquiry that the police are exploring. BBC Sport has contacted the Met for comment. Vigar's parents were present for the hearing at Barnet Coroner's Court on Thursday, as were representatives from the Football Association and Barnet Council. Former Bath City player Alex Fletcher, who fractured his skull when colliding with concrete barriers next to the club's pitch in 2022, was also present, as was another representative from the PFA. Camilla Vigar told senior coroner Andrew Walker: "I don't understand how the FA waited for Billy to die before they actioned anything when there was so much warning beforehand. "Ben Hiscox dying in 2015. Alex had his big accident in 2022. The investigation they did after that highlighted about 160 high-risk clubs. Wingate was one of them. They did nothing." Keith Vigar spoke during the hearing to raise an "issue with Barnet not being an interested party" in the case. "Personally I don't quite understand how the investigation carried out at the football club, Wingate and Finchley... I see it as a bit of a conflict of interest that Barnet as the local authority carried out that investigation. It feels like they are marking their own homework," he said. A further hearing has been scheduled for 10 February.

top.title: Obidient Movement congratulates Yunusa Tanko on appointment as SDP presidential campaign DG
top.description: The Obidient Movement has congratulated its former National Coordinator, Dr Yunusa Tanko, on his appointment as National Coordinator of the Social Democratic Party’s Presidential Campaign Council ahead of the 2027 general elections. The movement described the appointment as recognition of Tanko’s political experience, organisational skills and contributions to the struggle for a better Nigeria. In a statement issued on Wednesday by its Media and Communications Directorate, the group wished him success in his new role, saying his emergence reflected the leadership capacity developed within the movement. It said Tanko’s appointment, despite his move to a different political platform, should be seen as an opportunity for collaboration rather than a source of division. The movement explained that its membership extended beyond party lines, bringing together Nigerians from different ethnic, religious and social backgrounds around the shared aspiration for competent and accountable leadership. While encouraging its members to join the Nigeria Democratic Congress, the party of its principal, Peter Obi, it said it recognised that its supporters belonged to different political parties. “Consequently, the emergence of leaders from our Movement into influential positions across different political platforms should be a source of pride, not division,” the statement said. The group also cited Obi’s attendance at the inauguration of the presidential campaign office of Oyo State Governor, Seyi Makinde, as an example of his belief in cooperation across political differences. According to the movement, Obi has consistently maintained that national interest should take precedence over partisan considerations. It added that its objective was not to confine capable Nigerians to one political party but to develop leaders who could contribute to national development wherever they found themselves. Tanko was on Wednesday unveiled as the SDP’s national presidential campaign coordinator during the inauguration of the party’s campaign council in Abuja. He pledged to work with the party’s presidential candidate, Adewale Adebayo, and his running mate, Usman Bugaje, ahead of the 2027 elections. The appointment followed Tanko’s resignation as political adviser (North) to Obi, which he said took effect on October 30. top.title: Why I backed Tinubu in 2023 but will challenge him in 2027 — Makinde
top.description: By Ayobami Okerinde Three years after supporting President Bola Tinubu’s emergence in 2023, Oyo State Governor, Seyi Makinde, has explained why he is challenging him in the 2027 presidential election, citing four major concerns about the administration. Makinde, the presidential candidate of the Allied Peoples Movement (APM), said his decision was not driven by a personal disagreement with Tinubu or an ambition to occupy Aso Rock, but by what he described as concerns about Nigeria’s future. The governor stated this in a newsletter on Thursday, recalling that he backed Tinubu because he believed the president could unite Nigerians, build a government based on competence and address the country’s economic challenges. He said, “I supported President Tinubu in 2023 because I believed his experience and political relationships could help him bring Nigerians together. “One thing I have always acknowledged about him is his ability to build bridges across political divides. I believed he could use that ability to establish a government of national unity and competence, focused on improving the lives of Nigerians.” Makinde identified four major reasons for his decision to challenge Tinubu, beginning with what he described as “economic stability without economic development.” While acknowledging improvements in some macroeconomic indicators, he said such gains had not translated into better living conditions for ordinary Nigerians. “Also, contrary to the formula President Tinubu claims to be following, economic stabilisation and development are not necessarily sequential. Nigerians did not have to endure this level of hardship while waiting for development to begin,” he added. His second concern was what he described as “governing by excuses”, accusing the administration of repeatedly citing inherited challenges instead of showing measurable progress in tackling them. “Every government inherits problems, but it is elected to solve them. Over three years into this administration, we are still hearing explanations about inherited poverty, insecurity, electricity problems and other challenges, when Nigerians should be seeing more measurable progress towards resolving them.” On national unity, the governor said he had expected Tinubu’s political experience and ability to build alliances to produce a government that brought capable Nigerians together. “Instead, I have come to believe that his political alliances serve his political objectives more than the national interest, and I am deeply concerned about the weakening of opposition parties, which are essential to a functioning democracy,” Makinde said. His fourth concern was “economic reforms without adequate protection for Nigerians.” Although he supported reforms to the petrol subsidy and foreign exchange systems, Makinde said the government should have prepared measures to protect citizens from the resulting hardship. top.description: RC Lens reach agreement to re-hire Pierre Sage RC Lens have reached a verbal agreement to re-hire Pierre Sage, according to a report from Foot Mercato. Sage’s exit from Crystal Palace was confirmed on Thursday afternoon. The Frenchman joined the Premier League club from Lens over the summer, having led the latter to a second-place finish in Ligue 1. He is also the man that guided the club to their first-ever Coupe de France trophy. However, his stint in south London was shortlived. He left the club after just 16 games, 10 of which came in the Premier League. At the time of his departure, Crystal Palace were rock-bottom of the table. In his absence, Lens have been in crisis. top.title: Dodger notes: Shohei Ohtani plans, Scott Boras talks Tarik Skubal
top.description: LOS ANGELES, CALIFORNIA - AUGUST 13: Shohei Ohtani #17 and Tarik Skubal #29 of the Los Angeles Dodgers look out from the dugout during a 5-4 loss to the Milwaukee Brewers during the ninth inning at Dodger Stadium on August 13, 2026 in Los Angeles, California. (Photo by Harry How/Getty Images) | Getty Images Dodgers general manager Brandon Gomes talked with reporters Tuesday in Las Vegas, and added more to what the team is thinking as far as signing Tarik Skubal. Jacob Macofsky covered what he talked about in yesterday’s article. Wednesday, Skubal’s agent Scott Boras spoke with reporters and laid out more details about his client that is this year’s biggest free agent on the market. “Much like 2021, there’s a clear intent on a group of players, and we have no reservations by any teams that they’re going to operate within their abilities and freedoms because they want they don’t want to lose to their competitors,” Boras told reporters. “They want the market to be what it is for them, and they’re utilizing their rights to compete. I think they’re very concerned about losing the opportunity to sign select, key players, and they’re pursuing it aggressively.” Maddie Lee of the L.A. Times covers this and more of what Boras said about his highly sought after client, and what the Dodgers pitching staff needs and doesn’t necessarily need heading into the 2027 season (should there be one). Cody Stavenhagen of The Athletic also covers what else Boras is thinking in terms of the offseason and the possible impending lockout, and how in typical Boras fashion the news conference was a spectacle unto itself. The place that Boras’ team had picked to hold his annual press gaggle was not sanctioned by ARIA hotel, and thusly was moved to a different location. According to Stavenhagen, Boras strongly hinted that Skubal would sign before the impending lockout, as did his clients Marcus Semien and Corey Seager in 2021-22 before that season’s lockout. “I think they’re very concerned about losing the opportunity to sign select key players, and they are pursuing it aggressively,” Boras said. One pitcher who will definitely be on the team next season is Shohei Ohtani, but when he will first pitch for the Dodgers is not certain. As Fabian Ardaya of The Athletic discusses , the team is not sure when the two-way player will return to the mound. Brandon Gomes had this to say about Ohtani – “Whatever it is, there’s just a lot of different avenues, and I think for us to unilaterally decide that doesn’t make sense. So it’s really bringing him into the conversation and figuring out how to navigate a full season.” Lots to be decided in the coming weeks and months as the Dodgers look to reclaim the top spot in MLB from the Milwaukee Brewers.

top.title: Gary Player names the one-time major champion who was ‘a better golfer than Jack Nicklaus’
top.description: Photo by Kevin C. Cox/Getty Images Gary Player is never shy to speak his mind and that is what makes him such a captivating person to listen to when he is giving his opinions on the game. Player is one of the greatest golfers ever to have graced our wonderful game, with 159 professional victories to his name worldwide, including nine major championships. Meanwhile, Jack Nicklaus is the greatest of them all, certainly as far as his major win tally is concerned, with a record 18 to his name. Gary Player and Jack Nicklaus enjoyed a great rivalry on the golf course in the 1960s and 1970s, but they were really close friends off it as well. Player got the better of Nicklaus plenty of times during their prime years, but the American obviously had the last laugh, especially in the majors. Despite their close friendship, the South African always gives his honest opinion when asked about Nicklaus as a golfer. Player admires the 18-time major champion more than any other golfer he came up against, but there was one player who was even better than the great man according to the man from South Africa. Gary Player claims Tom Weiskopf was ‘a better golfer than Jack Nicklaus’ Player made an appearance on The Golfer’s Journal and discussed a wide range of topics concerning the professional game. As the conversation turned to Jack Nicklaus, Player claimed that the Golden Bear’s incredible mentality was what made him such an elite golfer. “ Tom Weiskopf was a better golfer than Nicklaus. He really could play. But he won one major because he did not have it! He had the technique but he did not have it (mentality), “ Player said. “ He still did extremely well, but he was not in the category of many majors. He won one major. With his technique he should have won 15. You can see that throughout life. You meet people in business, in marriage and it’s very interesting, to see how that mind works. “ I always tell people that all I hear about today is long-hitting. It’s an asset but it is not a necessity. What is a necessity is a special mind and to be a great putter. Driving, these pros hit eight of them a day, but they hit 29 putts, yet all the emphasis is put on driving. “ Tiger Woods won as a golfer because he was the best putter! “ Weiskopf won 16 PGA Tour titles during his career, including a solitary major championship after he triumphed at The Open in 1973. As Player said, he undoubtedly should have won more majors, such was the quality of his ball-striking. However, Gary Player suggesting that Tom Weiskopf was a better golfer than Jack Nicklaus is surely a huge exaggeration. Of course, Nicklaus arguably had the strongest mentality, but there were not many golfers who were better ball-strikers than him, and there definitely wasn’t anyone who putted better under pressure. Sure, Weiskopf should have won multiple majors, but he never was in the same league as Nicklaus, either mentally or as a golfer.

top.title: Devin McCourty urges Jonathan Taylor to go on strike after remaining with the Colts
top.description: Photo by Kevin Sabitus/Getty Images The Indianapolis Colts were busy in the weeks leading up to the trade deadline, but Jonathan Taylor was not one of the players who got to join a different team. Josh Downs and Keenan Allen both secured moves away from Indianapolis on Tuesday as they joined the Kansas City Chiefs and the San Francisco 49ers, respectively. However, star running back Taylor remains in Indy ahead of what could be a long stretch until the end of the season. The Colts have been nothing short of a disaster this year, having won just two of their nine games this season. Many around the league feel as if Taylor deserves much better than this, which has led to Devin McCourty insisting the 27-year-old must go on strike in the offseason – if needed – to earn himself a trade. Jonathan Taylor advised to go on strike to earn Indianapolis Colts exit The Colts were open to trading away Taylor, but it was apparent that teams were not willing to cough up a first-round pick for the running back. As a result, the 27-year-old remains in Indy while some of his former teammates may now compete for a Super Bowl. “Like, if I’m Jonathan Taylor, I’m trying as much as I can to force my way out of Indy this offseason. Like, I don’t want to be here. I’m not coming to offseason workouts. I’m doing whatever I can because you already told me that you didn’t really want me here. Or not that you didn’t want me here, you were going to turn my value into picks and try to get better for the future,” McCourty said on NBC. “Why do I want to line up and run behind an offensive line when you got rid of our best player? Like, it just doesn’t make sense. Despite playing for one of the worst teams in the NFL, Taylor has still been able to provide a solid return from the running back position. Taylor has racked up 656 rushing yards this season, and eight touchdowns. “I think when you do this as an organisation, and for weeks we’re talking about guys that are going to get traded and you decide to keep them, I just think the message you sent to your team was that not only are we failing on the football field, we failed as a front office to actually trade these guys when we knew we wanted to trade them. We suck at that, too. “Like, I just think it’s bad business as a team for the guys in the locker room. You don’t want to be a part of that. And even if you understand the business, be good at the business. Get rid of these guys. Let’s suck. Let’s let these young guys play. Let’s lose. Let’s get draft picks and then figure it out from there. top.title: ‘Should be suspended’ – Warriors fans demand NBA action over Stephen Curry’s injury
top.description: Photo by Kenneth Richmond/Getty Images It didn’t take long for angry Warriors fans to rewind the tape on Steph Curry’s injury. Golden State’s great start to the season just hit a wall. Steph Curry went down with an oblique injury, and right now, nobody knows how long the Warriors are going to be without him. While the team waits on test results to figure out a timeline, the timing couldn’t be much worse. The Warriors are staring down a tough stretch of games on the schedule, and trying to protect their early momentum without their best player on the floor is going to test the entire roster. Yaxel Lendeborg has stepped up, but not even he could get the Warriors over the line against the Rockets. Warriors fans blame Alperen Sengun for Stephen Curry’s injury Footage of the play between Alperen Sengun and Stephen Curry has been circulating all over social media, and it shows exactly what went wrong. Even though Curry seemed to initiate the tangle with Alperen Sengun, the Rockets center ended up trapping Curry’s arm and turning it upward as they broke apart. You can clearly see Curry wince in pain right after the collision, pointing to the exact moment the oblique injury likely happened. Warriors fans were quick to blame Alperen Sengun for the incident online. This fan started: “Hooks his arm and then yanks it. If someone does that to Sengun, he’s on the floor crying for 19 mins.” “Alperen Sengun should be suspended.” Said another. Another supporter touched on the treatment of Curry: “Look at what Stephen Curry constantly deals with man.” “Sengun needs to be suspended for this.” Another fan added. Lastly, this fan was annoyed: “They genuinely let you get away with anything in the NBA.” Even with all the noise from Warriors fans, the league isn’t going to hand down any punishment here. Looking closely at the replay, it really just comes across as an awkward basketball tangle in the heat of the moment, and Alperen Sengun didn’t seem to have any malicious intent behind it. top.title: Joe Mazzulla Explains Why NBA Locker Room Relationships Are More Complicated Than Fans Realize
top.description: Mandatory Credit: Troy Taormina-Imagn Images All the talk in the lead-up to Tuesday’s clash between the Boston Celtics and the Philadelphia 76ers at Xfinity Mobile Arena was about Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown’s relationship. Despite being teammates on the Celtics for nine seasons and enjoying success together, Tatum and Brown never appeared to be close friends, and weren’t on the best of terms when their partnership ended this past offseason. While fans at large have obsessed over this lack of relationship, Celtics head coach Joe Mazzulla thinks that is down to a lack of understanding. In his press conference before that Celtics-76ers game, Mazzulla was asked what’s different about NBA locker room relationships that people on the outside don’t understand. “One, I’ll tell you right now, all 30 teams, it’s not Boy Scouts,” Mazzulla said, via Celtics on CLNS. “We’re not all just sitting there getting along, and everyone’s happy-go-lucky. I mean, that’s just not how the world works. So to think that a group of guys are just supposed to just be happy with each other all the time. This isn’t camp. “We’re going after something that’s highly competitive and stressful, and there’s things at stake, and with that comes conflict,” Mazzulla continued. “Doesn’t mean it’s a bad thing. You work through things together. Secondly, you got people that are single, married, divorced, kids, no kids. People have been traded four times. People haven’t been traded at all.” An NBA locker room has players with different upbringings, who have different lifestyles and are at different stages in their careers. They might have great chemistry on the court as teammates, but might not necessarily get along off the court. If you ask the average NBA fan to name the greatest duos of all time, Michael Jordan – Scottie Pippen and Shaquille O’Neal – Kobe Bryant will be common answers. We’ve found out in recent years that Jordan and Pippen didn’t have a great relationship, but they still won six titles together. O’Neal and Bryant had a rough relationship off the court, but still won three championships. In Tatum and Brown’s case, they took the Celtics to the Eastern Conference Finals five times, advanced to the NBA Finals twice, and won a championship in 2024. They might not have been the best of friends, but they were great together on the court. That’s ultimately all that matters. top.title: Pierre Sage sacked as Palace manager after less than five months
top.description: FILE PHOTO - Crystal Palace manager Pierre Sage reacts during the English Premier League soccer match between Tottenham Hotspur and Crystal Palace at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium. (is associated with: «Pierre Sage sacked as Palace manager after less than five months») Jordan Pettitt/PA Wire/dpa Crystal Palace have sacked manager Pierre Sage less than five months after his appointment. The former Lens and Lyon boss succeeded Oliver Glasner in June but secured just two Premier League wins and one draw from 10 matches. Palace sit bottom of the table following Sunday’s 3-1 loss at home to Liverpool. Three members of Sage’s coaching staff – Jamal Alioui, Damien Della Santa and Sandy Guichard – have also left the club. “Crystal Palace Football Club can confirm that Pierre Sage has left his role as manager,” read a club statement. “The club would like to place on record its thanks to Pierre and his staff for their efforts during their time in south London, and wish them well for the future.” According to bookmakers, former Tottenham and Brentford boss Thomas Frank is the leading candidate to replace Sage. Palace are bottom of the table after a complete round of fixtures for the first time since December 2017. The Eagles have looked marginally better in other competitions, beating Fulham late last month to book a meeting with Sunderland in the League Cup quarter-finals. Their Europa League campaign has also been a mixed bag, with one win, two draws and one loss leaving them in 21st place after their first four matches. Glasner survived a nine-game Premier League winless run in February. But the Austrian, who joined Nottingham Forest in the summer, had credit in the bank, having led Palace to FA Cup and Conference League glory. Some have suggested Sage – last year’s Ligue 1 manager of the season after guiding Lens to a second-placed finish – was dealt a bad hand, pointing to other areas, including recruitment and injuries, as contributing factors. But even by his own admission, Palace have lacked consistency, conceding more goals – 24 – than any other top-flight club, while scoring 10, leaving them with the worst goal difference in the division.

top.description: Josh Kelly will take on Jaron “Boots” Ennis in a mouthwatering world-title fight, it has been confirmed. On 27 February, Kelly will take on Ennis in Atlanta, Georgia, as the pair unify their super-welterweight belts at State Farm Arena. Britain’s Kelly will enter the bout as IBF champion, while his American foe holds the WBA and WBO titles. The contest surely marks the toughest test of Kelly’s career, as the Sunderland boxer aims to become the first fighter to beat Ennis. Last time out, Ennis stopped Xander Zayas to collect his belts , handing the Puerto Rican his first professional loss. Boots dropped Zayas in rounds one and five, before doing the same in round seven to end the fight. The result also crowned Ennis, 29, a two-weight champion, following his unified-title reign at welterweight. Kelly realised his own world-title dream in January, outpointing Bakhram Murtazaliev to become IBF champion , before retaining the belt with a decision win over Caoimhin Agyarko in July. Both opponents were undefeated before facing Kelly, who will therefore believe he can end Ennis’s own unbeaten run. Kelly, 32, has lost just once as a pro – a stoppage defeat by David Avanesyan in 2021 – and his record also includes a 2019 draw with Ray Robinson. Jaron Ennis dropped Xander Zayas in three separate rounds (Cris Esqueda/Matchroom Boxing) Of Kelly’s 19 wins, nine have come via KO/TKO, while Ennis has 32 KOs from 36 victories. “It’s that time again!” Ennis said in a press release on Wednesday. “I’m adding another belt to the collection. I’m going to keep knocking them down one by one.” Kelly added: “I’ve waited a very long time to prove myself at the highest level – finally I have that moment.” And Matchroom’s Eddie Hearn , who promotes both boxers, said: “What a fantastic unification fight this is. Boots and Josh are both brilliant world champions. This was not a difficult fight to make when you lay out what is there for the winner – three belts around your waist, and just one more to collect to become undisputed at 154 and lay the foundations to a legacy in the sport.”

top.title: Hackers exploiting ScreenConnect plugin flaw to spread malware across hundreds of PCs
top.description: Hackers have used a dodgy third-party ScreenConnect extension to push malware onto at least 288 machines across 48 organizations, prompting ConnectWise to disable a handful of plugins in hundreds of customer environments. Security outfit Huntress first raised the alarm in a Reddit post on Wednesday, warning of an active campaign targeting cloud-hosted ScreenConnect instances. At the time, its security operations center was tracking six compromised managed service providers (MSPs) and more than 286 affected endpoints, with the numbers still climbing. ConnectWise acquired popular remote supporttool ScreenConnect in February, 2015. Huntress spotted the attacks at around 1747 UTC, when someone began using ScreenConnect's remote command feature to install rogue clients on machines managed by multiple IT service providers. All 288 endpoints were hit within 90 minutes, with roughly a third compromised in the first ten minutes. Huntress suspects more MSPs may have been compromised, as the attackers appeared to be numbering their victims sequentially, with the numbers suggesting earlier attacks that it hadn't detected. The attackers deployed a 16-file malware toolkit dubbed SCKit, which installs a separate ScreenConnect client to maintain remote access even if the legitimate connection is shut down. It also contains code designed to spread the infection to IT technicians and potentially other customers under their control. Huntress has since traced the activity to a possible authentication weakness in RMM+, a third-party extension that lets other management tools issue commands through ScreenConnect without technicians using its console. Versions 1.0.31 and 1.0.32 of the extension contain a flaw that means installations without a configured access key will accept a blank one. Because RMM+ operates independently of ScreenConnect's normal user accounts and authentication controls, an attacker could potentially execute commands without defeating MFA. Huntress said the findings matched what its investigators saw during the attacks, with commands reaching machines across several ScreenConnect installations despite no corresponding login activity. The researchers also confirmed that the attacks affected ScreenConnect versions 26.6.6.9747 and 26.7.6.9783, meaning administrators running the latest releases weren't necessarily safe. ConnectWise has acknowledged that third-party extensions may have been involved but has stopped short of confirming how the attackers initially gained access. In a security advisory , the company said it was investigating unauthorized access to certain partner environments and had identified approximately 400 installations containing at least one extension from the RMM+ family. It has disabled five extensions, including RMM+, RMM Plus, and Labtech Plus, wherever it can do so remotely, and urged customers running their own ScreenConnect servers to follow suit. top.description: Harry Kane England 2026 World Cup - Getty Record-breaking Kane now a Ballon d'Or winner Ballon d’Or winner Kane, who was recently crowned as the best player on the planet , made his senior international bow back in 2015. Few could have predicted at that stage what the next decade or so would bring. Against Croatia on Thursday, in a UEFA Nations League fixture, he will represent his nation for the 126th time and overtake Peter Shilton on the appearance front. top.title: Tale of the tape: How Zach Johnson, Stewart Cink fared head-to-head in 2026
top.description: PHOENIX — It'll be a two-man race for the 2026 Charles Schwab Cup, and it could be best described as a friendly competition. That's because the two men involved, the only two mathematically alive to win it, are best buds. Stewart Cink, the defending Cup champion with five wins this season, is going mano a mano with Champions tour rookie Zach Johnson, second in points but first in wins with six. Competitors till the end, the two are close off the golf course as well. "He's legitimately one of my best friends in the world," Johnson said of Cink on Tuesday ahead of his practice round at Phoenix Country Club. "I would say the family is as well. The fact that one of us will hold it [the trophy] and the other one, I'm telling you, I'll be the first one to give him a hug if I don't win it." Cink tried to downplay the concept of this being just a two-man competition. "We're playing against a lot more than each other, me and Zach. There's 34 other players that are very capable here in this field," he said. "It's going to be a lot of fun. This is what you really play golf for." They say it's difficult to win, but more difficult to repeat but that's what Cink, the defending Schwab tournament and season-long Schwab points champion, faces this week. "I feel a little bit more pressure because I'm in the reverse scenario from what I was last year. Last year I was Zach," I was like 'win and I win,' but otherwise I wasn't going to win this thing [the points title]. So I was very focused on one thing," Cink said, meaning a year ago he came into this as the No. 2 seed. "As the frontrunner, you feel a little bit more pressure. That's just the way it is in this game." But ultimately Cink echoed Johnson's friendly sentiment. "If Zach wins, then I'm going to high five him and hug him and be very proud of him, and if I win, I'm sure he'll do the same thing for me," Cink said. And now it comes down to this: 72 holes (the only tournament aside from the majors with 72 holes) over four days to determine the 2026 champion. There's a tournament trophy to be won as well, and Cink a year ago became just the third to win both trophies since 2003. But there will also be some friendly bragging rights Sunday night and beyond. nigeria.title: Court orders Maina’s son to serve seven-year jail term
nigeria.description: …..Faisal to serve sentence concurrently from October 14 re-arrest A Federal High Court in Abuja has ordered the remand of Faisal Maina, son of former Chairman of the defunct Pension Reform Task Team, Abdulrasheed Maina, in a correctional centre to serve his seven-year jail term for money laundering. Justice James Omotosho made the order on Thursday after granting an ex parte application filed by the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC). The commission had asked the court to issue a warrant committing Faisal to the Nigeria Correctional Service (NCoS) to enforce the judgment convicting him of money laundering and failure to make full disclosure in an asset declaration form. Faisal was arrested by the Department of State Services (DSS) on October 14 in the Karsana area of Abuja, about six years after he jumped bail and absconded from trial. He was subsequently handed over to the EFCC. In its application, the commission also sought an order directing that his prison sentence should commence from October 14, the date of his re-arrest. After the EFCC’s lawyer, M.K. Hussain, moved the application, Justice Omotosho granted the reliefs sought and issued a warrant for Faisal’s commitment to a correctional centre. The judge ordered that, in line with the Court of Appeal’s judgment of November 24, 2022, Faisal should serve three years’ imprisonment on count one, seven years on count two and three years on count three. The sentences are to run concurrently, beginning from October 14, 2026, when he was re-arrested. Faisal was arraigned before the Federal High Court in Abuja in 2019 on a three-count charge bordering on money laundering and failure to fully disclose his assets. He pleaded not guilty to the charges before Justice Okon Abang, who was then presiding over the case, but later jumped bail and stopped attending court proceedings. Following his disappearance, Abang proceeded with the trial in his absence and convicted him on October 7, 2021. The court initially sentenced him to five years’ imprisonment on counts one and three, and 14 years on count two, with the sentences to run concurrently. Abang also ordered that Faisal be arrested wherever he was found and taken to a correctional centre to serve his sentence. However, the Court of Appeal subsequently upheld the conviction but reduced the sentences in its judgment delivered on November 24, 2022, to three years on counts one and three, and seven years on count two. Faisal’s father, Abdulrasheed, was also convicted in a separate money laundering case involving about N2 billion. He has since completed his prison term. nigeria.title: BOA earmarks N200bn for 400,000 dry-season farmers
nigeria.description: …..FMN targets five tonnes of wheat per hectare in 2026/2027 farming season By Muhammad Inuwa, Dutse The Bank of Agriculture (BOA) has earmarked about N200 billion to finance dry-season agricultural activities for 400,000 farmers across Nigeria as part of efforts to boost domestic food production and strengthen food security. The North-West Zonal Manager of the bank, Abdul-Razaq Datti Saleh, disclosed this at the flag-off of the 2026/2027 dry-season wheat farming programme organised in partnership with Flour Mills of Nigeria (FMN) at Maje Village, Taura Local Government Area of Jigawa State. Saleh explained that the financing would be channelled through farmer aggregator companies to enable individual farmers to access support for land preparation, irrigation, improved seeds, fertilisers and other essential agricultural inputs. He said the partnership with FMN was aimed at increasing domestic wheat production, reducing Nigeria’s dependence on imported wheat and strengthening food security. According to him, wheat remains an important raw material for households and industries, adding that expanding local production would create employment opportunities, increase farmers’ incomes and strengthen rural economies. Also speaking, the General Manager of Golden Agro Input Limited (GAIL), a subsidiary of FMN Agro, Engineer Tayo Ilori, said the company was supporting 10,000 farmers across six states under the 2026 dry-season wheat programme. He explained that each participating farmer received agricultural inputs for one hectare, comprising 100 kilogrammes of wheat seeds, six bags of urea, four bags of NPK 20:10:5 fertiliser and chemicals for weed and pest control. Ilori estimated the value of the input package at between N250,000 and N350,000 per hectare. He said the inputs were provided as loans, which farmers would repay with harvested wheat grains at prevailing market prices rather than through cash payments. Ilori identified improved seeds, quality fertilisers and regular extension services as critical factors in increasing wheat productivity. He added that GAIL had deployed about 250 lead outgrowers to provide technical guidance and support to participating farmers across the six states. The company, he said, was targeting a yield of seven metric tonnes per hectare in the 2026/2027 season, expressing confidence that the target was achievable through the adoption of modern farming practices. The Project Director, Engineer Olusegun Falade, said the programme had raised average wheat productivity from less than one tonne per hectare at its inception to about 4.2 tonnes, with some farmers recording yields of up to 7.2 tonnes. Falade identified farmers’ reluctance to repay loans, slow adoption of improved farming practices and land ownership challenges as some of the obstacles confronting the programme. nigeria.title: Obidient Movement congratulates Yunusa Tanko on appointment as SDP presidential campaign DG
nigeria.description: The Obidient Movement has congratulated its former National Coordinator, Dr Yunusa Tanko, on his appointment as National Coordinator of the Social Democratic Party’s Presidential Campaign Council ahead of the 2027 general elections. The movement described the appointment as recognition of Tanko’s political experience, organisational skills and contributions to the struggle for a better Nigeria. In a statement issued on Wednesday by its Media and Communications Directorate, the group wished him success in his new role, saying his emergence reflected the leadership capacity developed within the movement. It said Tanko’s appointment, despite his move to a different political platform, should be seen as an opportunity for collaboration rather than a source of division. The movement explained that its membership extended beyond party lines, bringing together Nigerians from different ethnic, religious and social backgrounds around the shared aspiration for competent and accountable leadership. While encouraging its members to join the Nigeria Democratic Congress, the party of its principal, Peter Obi, it said it recognised that its supporters belonged to different political parties. “Consequently, the emergence of leaders from our Movement into influential positions across different political platforms should be a source of pride, not division,” the statement said. The group also cited Obi’s attendance at the inauguration of the presidential campaign office of Oyo State Governor, Seyi Makinde, as an example of his belief in cooperation across political differences. According to the movement, Obi has consistently maintained that national interest should take precedence over partisan considerations. It added that its objective was not to confine capable Nigerians to one political party but to develop leaders who could contribute to national development wherever they found themselves. Tanko was on Wednesday unveiled as the SDP’s national presidential campaign coordinator during the inauguration of the party’s campaign council in Abuja. He pledged to work with the party’s presidential candidate, Adewale Adebayo, and his running mate, Usman Bugaje, ahead of the 2027 elections. The appointment followed Tanko’s resignation as political adviser (North) to Obi, which he said took effect on October 30. nigeria.title: Why I backed Tinubu in 2023 but will challenge him in 2027 — Makinde
nigeria.description: By Ayobami Okerinde Three years after supporting President Bola Tinubu’s emergence in 2023, Oyo State Governor, Seyi Makinde, has explained why he is challenging him in the 2027 presidential election, citing four major concerns about the administration. Makinde, the presidential candidate of the Allied Peoples Movement (APM), said his decision was not driven by a personal disagreement with Tinubu or an ambition to occupy Aso Rock, but by what he described as concerns about Nigeria’s future. The governor stated this in a newsletter on Thursday, recalling that he backed Tinubu because he believed the president could unite Nigerians, build a government based on competence and address the country’s economic challenges. He said, “I supported President Tinubu in 2023 because I believed his experience and political relationships could help him bring Nigerians together. “One thing I have always acknowledged about him is his ability to build bridges across political divides. I believed he could use that ability to establish a government of national unity and competence, focused on improving the lives of Nigerians.” Makinde identified four major reasons for his decision to challenge Tinubu, beginning with what he described as “economic stability without economic development.” While acknowledging improvements in some macroeconomic indicators, he said such gains had not translated into better living conditions for ordinary Nigerians. “Also, contrary to the formula President Tinubu claims to be following, economic stabilisation and development are not necessarily sequential. nigeria.title: Oil wells verification to ensure fair sharing of 13% derivation fund — RMAFC
nigeria.description: By Emmanuel Iheaka The Revenue Mobilisation, Allocation and Fiscal Commission (RMAFC) has said the ongoing verification of oil and gas wells across the country is aimed at ensuring equitable distribution of the 13 per cent derivation fund among producing states. The Chairman of the Commission and Chairman of the Executive Committee of the Inter-Agency Technical Committee (IATC), Dr. Mohammed Shehu, stated this in Owerri, Imo State, during the flag-off of a field verification exercise covering disputed and newly drilled crude oil and gas wells. Shehu said the commission was constitutionally empowered to ensure the equitable disbursement of the 13 per cent derivation fund to oil and gas-producing states. He explained that the reconstituted IATC convened in Owerri to formally commence the verification exercise covering disputed and newly drilled crude oil and gas wells from 2017 to date. According to him, the committee’s terms of reference include examining and verifying the coordinates of disputed and newly drilled oil and gas wells, conducting physical inspections of the affected wells and ensuring the accurate plotting of verified coordinates. He said the committee was also mandated to ensure that only approved maps were used in plotting coordinates and that relevant court decisions were considered in resolving disputes involving oil and gas wells. Other responsibilities, he said, include submitting its findings and reports exclusively to RMAFC for ratification and adoption, as well as addressing other related matters arising from its field operations. Shehu described the exercise as a crucial step towards ensuring statutory accuracy, technical reliability and fiscal equity in the Federation Account allocation framework. He said the determination of the exact coordinates and geographical positions of oil and gas wellheads directly affected the legal and financial entitlements of the respective sub-national entities. The RMAFC chairman consequently charged all technical officers deployed for the exercise to carry out the national assignment with diligence, technical precision and professionalism. He stressed that every verified coordinate, technical assessment and physical observation made during the exercise must be capable of withstanding rigorous statutory scrutiny. Shehu further directed that the harmonised technical report be submitted exclusively to the commission for administrative processing and formal adoption. nigeria.title: Gunmen kill young man near Imo varsity in Owerri
nigeria.description: By Emmanuel Iheaka Unidentified gunmen have shot dead a young man suspected to be a student near the Bishop’s Court area, close to the Imo State University, Owerri. The attackers reportedly stormed a car wash facility in the area in a Lexus Jeep and opened fire on the victim before fleeing the scene. The incident threw residents and business operators in the area into panic, as people scampered for safety following the shooting. An eyewitness said the assailants initially appeared to have brought their vehicle for washing before launching the attack. “They came to a car spot in a Lexus Jeep, acting as if they wanted to wash the car. The next we heard was a gunshot, and the young man was in a pool of blood. They zoomed off. Nobody can actually say what led to the attack,” the source said. The motive for the killing was yet to be established as of the time of filing this report. The incident comes amid reports of clashes between rival cult groups in parts of Imo State, which have reportedly claimed lives in the past month. The police had about three weeks ago announced the arrest of some suspects in connection with the attacks, adding that investigations were ongoing to apprehend other persons involved. In response to the security concerns, the Commissioner of Police in the state, CP Audu Garba Bosso, convened a strategic security meeting on October 18, 2026, with Area Commanders, Divisional Police Officers and Tactical Team Commanders to assess the situation and strengthen security operations across the state. Following the meeting, operational commanders were directed to intensify intelligence-led operations, conduct targeted raids on identified criminal hideouts, strengthen patrols in security hotspots and respond promptly to emerging threats. The commissioner also directed closer collaboration with community leaders, youth groups and other stakeholders to improve intelligence gathering and prevent further violence. However, the Police Public Relations Officer in the state, Henry Okoye, was yet to react to the latest killing as of the time of filing this report. nigeria.title: ‘Not the solution’, ‘ludicrous’, Man Utd legends, English pundits react to Carrick’s sacking
nigeria.description: By Adegboyega Adeleye Manchester United have sacked Michael Carrick after days of speculation over his future, following the club’s poor start to the Premier League season. The decision came after United’s hierarchy reviewed the team’s performances and considered possible replacements, with Mauricio Pochettino lined up for the job. But before the dismissal on Thursday, some prominent voices had questioned whether sacking Carrick would solve United’s problems, while others argued he should have been allowed to stay. United legends questioned whether a sacking would solve the problems Former United captain Gary Neville said changing managers would not address the club’s deeper issues. Speaking to NBC Sports, he warned that United risked repeating a cycle of brief improvement followed by a return to poor performances. Neville said eight managerial changes in 12 years showed that replacing the head coach alone was “not the answer”. He pointed to poor recruitment, weaknesses in the performance department and a lack of strong leadership throughout the club. Joined by his brother Gary on NBC Sports , former United defender Phil Neville focused on the defence after the 4-4 draw with Aston Villa, saying the back four that finished the match was not good enough for the Premier League and could get a manager sacked. Roy Keane had also criticised Carrick’s comments on Sky Sports after the Villa game, saying the head coach “talks a lot but doesn’t say much”. Keane questioned what would change if United continued conceding goals and chances. Paul Scholes, meanwhile, had looked ahead to United’s next appointment. Speaking on The Good, The Bad and The Football, he backed Antonio Conte over Eddie Howe and Julian Nagelsmann, while warning that Conte would come with “a big warning”. Other English pundits have their say as Carragher calls the prospect of sacking Carrick ‘ludicrous’ Former Liverpool captain Jamie Carragher had called the prospect of dismissing Carrick “ludicrous” before the decision was made. He argued Carrick should help United through a difficult period before the club appointed a top-level manager in the summer. Jamie Redknapp had earlier said the squad lacked the quality and structure needed to turn the season around, adding that Carrick needed help with the players available to him. Former England international Chris Waddle, speaking after United’s draw with Tottenham in September, said the team had lost confidence and needed to rebuild it. nigeria.title: Triton cabin crew’s medical certificate invalid during mid-air door incident – NSIB
nigeria.description: By Dickson Omobola Nigerian Safety Investigation Bureau, NSIB, has disclosed that the flight crew of a Bombardier Challenger 604 aircraft, with nationality and registration marks T7-SEI, operated by Triton Aviation Limited, observed an abnormal increase in cabin altitude and suspected a pressurisation issue at 17:19, before its passenger-crew door detached during initial climb. NSIB also revealed that the cabin crew’s medical certificate was not valid at the time of that occurrence. Recall that on October 15, 2026, the serious incident occurred after the aircraft took-off from Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport, Abuja. The aircraft, operating as DWC052, was conducting a non-scheduled flight from Abuja to Murtala Muhammed International Airport, Lagos, with nine persons on board, comprising two flight crew members, one cabin crew member and six passengers. NSIB, in its preliminary report, stated that the captain subsequently instructed the cabin crew to double-check the main cabin door, adding that as the cabin crew approached the passenger-crew door to carry out the inspection, the door opened and subsequently detached from the aircraft. Director-General/Chief Executive Officer of NSIB, Captain Alex Badeh Jr, who signed the report, stated that the flight crew subsequently declared an emergency and coordinated with Abuja Air Traffic Control, ATC, for an immediate return to the airport. The report reads: “The aircraft landed safely on Runway 22 at approximately 17:34 local time. All nine occupants disembarked without injury. The aircraft sustained substantial damage. “Following notification of the occurrence on the same day, the NSIB immediately deployed investigators to the site to search for and recover the detached door, and commenced post-occurrence assessments. The detached door was subsequently recovered from a cornfield in Gui Village, Abuja Municipal Area Council, approximately five miles southwest of the airport. “The bureau reiterates that the preliminary report contains the factual information established during the investigation to date, including initial findings based on the evidence currently available and immediate safety recommendations arising from safety issues identified at this stage of the investigation. The report does not include analysis or conclusions regarding the causes or contributing factors associated with the occurrence, as the investigation remains ongoing. The bureau will publish its final report, including its analysis, conclusions, and further safety recommendations where appropriate, upon completion of the investigation in accordance with ICAO Annex 13 to the Convention on International Civil Aviation.” The post Triton cabin crew’s medical certificate invalid during mid-air door incident – NSIB appeared first on Vanguard News .

nigeria.title: Nobody defended Peter Obi like Yunusa Tanko in the North — Shehu Sani
nigeria.description: Former Kaduna Central Senator, Shehu Sani, has said Yunusa Tanko was one of the strongest advocates of Peter Obi in northern Nigeria, following his departure from the Obidient Movement and appointment to the Social Democratic Party’s 2027 presidential campaign council. Sani expressed surprise at Tanko’s decision to part ways with Obi, given his commitment to promoting the former Labour Party presidential candidate in the North. In a post on X on Wednesday, the former lawmaker wrote: “Nobody in the Northern part of River Niger has fanatically defended and promoted Dr Peter like Dr Yunusa Tanko. What must have happened for Dr Yunusa to part ways with Dr Peter? Anyway, nothing is impossible in politics.” Tanko, who previously coordinated the Obidient Movement, was on Wednesday named national coordinator of the SDP Presidential Campaign Council for the 2027 election. His appointment was announced at the inauguration of the party’s campaign council in Abuja, where he pledged to work with its presidential candidate, Adewale Adebayo, and running mate, Usman Bugaje, towards securing victory at the polls. Explaining his political realignment, Tanko said he resigned as political adviser (North) to Obi on October 30. He linked the decision to his appointment to the leadership of the National Consultative Front (NCFront), following the death of its former co-chairman and ex-Speaker of the House of Representatives, Ghali Na’Abba. Tanko also disclosed that he had contacted Obi and the National Democratic Congress leader, Seriake Dickson, to inform them of his decision. He acknowledged their support during his time as coordinator of the Obidient Movement and expressed appreciation for their contributions. The SDP campaign coordinator said his relationship with Adebayo predated the latest appointment, adding that they had worked together since 2023 and shared a commitment to building a better Nigeria. He also described the SDP as a left-wing, people-oriented party that represents the interests of ordinary Nigerians, particularly those he said had been neglected. Agbese, who represents Ado/Okpokwu/Ogbadigbo Federal Constituency of Benue State, said the proposed N10.8 trillion external borrowing must translate into infrastructure development, job creation and improved living conditions for Nigerians. nigeria.title: 2027: City Boy Movement targets 500,000 Enugu students for Tinubu
nigeria.description: By Chinedu Adonu The City Boy Movement has launched a membership registration drive across tertiary institutions in Enugu State, targeting 500,000 students as part of its mobilisation efforts for President Bola Tinubu’s re-election in 2027. The South-East Zonal Coordinator of the movement’s Membership Registration and Data Management, Dr. Onyeka Nwafor, disclosed this during a membership registration exercise in Enugu. Nwafor said the movement had partnered with the Council of Students’ Union Government Presidents in Enugu State (COSPEN) to expand its membership base and mobilise students across campuses in support of Tinubu’s second-term ambition. He said the initiative was aimed at strengthening the movement’s presence in the South-East and demonstrating student support for the President’s administration. Also speaking, the COSPEN Chairman and President of the Students’ Union Government of the Institute of Management and Technology (IMT), Enugu, Comrade Emmanuel Nwankwo, said student leaders had endorsed Tinubu’s re-election bid, citing the impact of the Nigerian Education Loan Fund (NELFUND). Nwankwo pledged that the council would mobilise more than 500,000 students for the registration exercise. He spoke during a meeting with Nwafor at Tiger Bar, Enugu, where both parties discussed strategies for expanding membership registration and improving coordination across campuses. “Many of our peers would have dropped out of school because of financial constraints, but NELFUND has eased the burden on parents and helped students remain in school. For this, we believe Mr President deserves a second term,” he said. Describing COSPEN as the gatekeepers of tertiary institutions in the state, Nwankwo said the student loan scheme had helped address some of the financial difficulties confronting students. Nwafor, a former governorship aspirant of the All Progressives Congress (APC) in Anambra State, said the movement was determined to expand its presence across tertiary institutions in the South-East. “We have resolved to scale up registration across campuses in Enugu. The registration exercise will demonstrate the level of student support for President Tinubu’s administration, particularly the impact of the student loan initiative,” he said. He added that COSPEN would coordinate the mobilisation exercise through student union presidents across the various institutions. nigeria.title: Nigeria, Jamaica advance talks on bilateral aviation agreement
nigeria.description: By Dickson Omobola Following a meeting between the Minister of Aviation and Aerospace Development, Festus Keyamo, and the Jamaican High Commissioner to Nigeria, Lincoln Downer, Nigeria and Jamaica are set to strengthen bilateral aviation relations as both countries move closer to concluding and signing their reviewed Bilateral Air Services Agreement, BASA. Disclosing details of the meeting in a statement, Special Adviser on Media and Communications to the Minister, Tunde Moshood, said the meeting focused on the finalisation of the existing BASA between the two countries, with particular emphasis on enhancing air travel, improving connectivity and creating a stronger framework for aviation cooperation between both countries. Moshood stated that the agreement had undergone extensive legal and technical reviews by officials of both countries, with the respective teams working to perfect the necessary documentation ahead of its formal endorsement. According to him, during the meeting, Downer expressed satisfaction with the progress made so far, noting that both countries had reached a critical stage in the process and were now looking towards setting a date for the signing. He was quoted to have said: “We are pleased now that we are at the point where we can now sign. We shared the legally reviewed text with your team, so I haven’t heard from them. That’s what I wanted to know today, where we stand, so that we can then set the date. You can give us an update?” The statement added: “In response, Keyamo requested the relevant file to ascertain the status of the documentation. He was briefed that the agreement had already undergone the necessary review by the Office of the Attorney-General of the Federation and had been returned, with the process now at an advanced stage of completion. “The Minister subsequently directed that a final copy of the agreement be made available to the Jamaican High Commissioner for a final review and proofreading to ensure that both parties are fully satisfied with the text before proceeding to the signing. “Both sides are now working towards agreeing on a mutually convenient date for the formal endorsement, tentatively scheduled to take place in Kingston, Jamaica, either in the last week of November or the first week of December 2026.” The post Nigeria, Jamaica advance talks on bilateral aviation agreement appeared first on Vanguard News .

nigeria.title: Chinese woman accused of spying on Nvidia chief entered Taiwan 8 times
nigeria.description: The woman accused of spying for Beijing during an affair with Nvidia founder Jensen Huang visited Taiwan a total of eight times in 2024 and 2025, a Taiwanese government minister said Thursday. Taiwan, a dominant player in the global semiconductor industry, sits at the centre of strategic competition between the United States and China, which claims the self-ruled island as part of its territory. Jensen Huang, chief executive of the US-based chip giant Nvidia, has admitted to having an extramarital affair, reportedly with Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed who US officials believe was working for Chinese intelligence. Beijing has rejected the spying allegations. Alice Huang, who is also known as Huang Le, used a Hong Kong passport to enter Taiwan “under a standard business visitor status” and there were “no special flags” about her at the time, Mainland Affairs Council (MAC) Minister Chiu Chui-cheng told lawmakers. Chiu made the remarks in Taiwan’s parliament in response to lawmakers’ questions about Alice Huang’s entries into Taiwan and a New York Times report that the United States had advised Taiwan as early as 2024 to monitor her movements. “At least we at the Mainland Affairs Council did not receive any relevant information,” Chiu said. “If we had, we definitely would have stepped up our entry screening and border flow management.” Chiu said records show that Alice Huang visited Taiwan three times in 2024 and five times in 2025. The records do not show any entries for this year, he said. “If we had any of the kind of critical intelligence you mentioned, leading us to believe she posed a threat to Taiwanese society, we would have definitely flagged her for heightened review,” Chiu said. “For any case where there are doubts, we intensify the level of scrutiny, and if we determine there are security concerns, there is no way we would allow her to enter the country.” The government has said Taiwan’s security agencies are investigating the incident. Cabinet spokeswoman Michelle Lee said Thursday “there is currently no public information” about whether Alice Huang “is suspected of any criminal offence or on the related investigative procedures”. “If a criminal offence is involved, due to the principle of prosecutorial confidentiality during an ongoing investigation, we cannot provide any further comment,” Lee said. Alice Huang was seen at a dinner in May 2025 hosted by Jensen Huang at a Chinese restaurant in Taipei during Computex, the island’s top tech expo. Journalists stood outside the restaurant filming through glass windows and doors as Jensen Huang and a woman identified as Alice Huang, who was wearing a pink dress, mingled with other attendees. At one point, Jensen Huang can be seen putting his arm around Alice Huang as she kisses him on the right cheek, press livestreams show. Olajengbesi made the allegation in an open letter addressed to elders and stakeholders of Ijesa North, both at home and abroad, in which he urged the people to resist what he described as an attempt to extend the tenure of the incumbent lawmaker, Wole Oke, to 28 years. nigeria.title: Two French Guards Collapse As Macron Welcomes Slovak President
nigeria.description: Two members of France’s elite Republican Guard collapsed almost simultaneously outside the Elysee Palace as President Emmanuel Macron welcomed his Slovak counterpart, according to televised images and a presidential source. As is customary for the arrival of foreign heads of state, the Republican Guards formed an honour guard in full ceremonial dress with sabres for the arrival of Slovak President Peter Pellegrini late Wednesday. One guard can be seen swaying before crashing to the ground, falling against a pillar at the Elysee Palace as his ceremonial sword clattered to the ground. France’s President Emmanuel Macron (R) bids farewell to Slovakia’s President Peter Pellegrini following their meeting at the Elysee presidential Palace in Paris on November 11, 2026. (Photo by Guillaume Saligot / AFP) | Guillaume Saligot / AFP Aides and Macron immediately rushed towards the stricken guard, images from an AFP photographer showed. Le Parisien daily said that a second guard collapsed off camera, with Macron looking concerned and then hurriedly welcoming his Slovak counterpart. A French presidential source, who asked not to be named, told AFP that both guards had suffered from “fainting attacks” and no other comment would be made. “Both of them were swiftly taken care of, and everything is fine,” added the source. The Republican Guard, part of the French gendarmerie, is responsible for guards of honour in France, which often involve standing for long periods in heavy clothing while holding their sword vertically. France’s President Emmanuel Macron (L) and other officials attend to a Republican Guard who fainted while standing at attention, as he waits the arrival of Slovakia’s President at the Elysee Palace in Paris on November 11, 2026. The decision is part of MSCI’s November 2026 Index Review , posted shortly after 5 p.m. ET. Official additions and deletions lists show Strategy (MSTR) out of its USA Index, which also takes it out of the broader MSCI World and ACWI indexes. The same review deletes Japan’s Metaplanet from the MSCI Japan Small Cap Index and uranium holder Yellow Cake from the MSCI United Kingdom Small Cap Index, and it removes Iceland’s Skel Fjárfestingafélag from the MSCI Iceland Frontier Markets Small Cap Index and micro-cap Upexi from the USA Micro Cap Index. All five had already been marked Deleted on MSCI’s potential-impact list , built on Sept. 30 financial data and Oct. 9 market values. Strategy is the only large-cap name in the group and, on that October list, accounted for more than 90% of the five companies’ combined float-adjusted market value. The company held 850,364 bitcoin as of Nov. 8, acquired at an average price of $75,456 a coin, or $64.16 billion in aggregate. Strategy shares closed at $122.35, up 1.06%, then slipped 1.51% to $120.50 in after-hours trading as of 5:34 p.m. ET. How the MSCI screen works The rule does not mention bitcoin. The index first checks whether a company’s operating assets equal at least 50% of total assets. Issuers that fail that core screen face five financial ratios, and a company flagged on four or more of them is ineligible for the MSCI Global Investable Market Indexes. Buffers limit turnover. A company outside the indexes cannot be added if it fails the ineligibility screen in either of its two most recent annual filing periods, but a current constituent is removed only if it fails in each of them. The index said it may also use the most recent interim filing. MSCI also said Wednesday that the same non-operating treatment will apply to the MSCI US Index Series. The screen replaces an approach aimed squarely at crypto. The index first proposed in late 2025 to exclude companies whose digital assets made up 50% or more of total assets, then dropped that plan in January and opened a broader consultation in August. It adopted the new methodology on Oct. 15, with minor modifications, and said it would end the interim measures it had placed on those companies in October 2025, including a freeze on share-count increases and a deferral of additions. entertainment.title: How to Style a Pink Buba With a Mini Skirt: Alex Unusual’s Loving Itohan Look
entertainment.description: Alex Unusual’s gold grillz, crystal floral choker, and cherub-accented sunglasses. Who says a buba has to be paired with a wrapper? Nigerian actress, media personality, and reality television star Asogwa Alexandra A —popularly known as Alex Unusua l—is giving us another way to wear the traditional Yoruba top, and her look for the premiere of Loving Itohan makes a strong case for pairing it with a mini skirt. The actress chose a bright fuchsia satin buba with wide half-sleeves, styling it with a fitted mini skirt made from emerald-green and magenta floral brocade damask . It’s an interesting way to rethink the familiar iro and bubacombination: keep the traditional top, swap the wrapper for a shorter skirt, and let the difference in fabric and colour give the outfit its character. The smooth finish of the pink satin against the patterned damask also shows how to wear two statement fabrics without making them compete . The trick is to give each piece a clear role, with the pink buba providing a bold block of colour and the brocade bringing in pattern and texture. Alex Unusual puts a modern spin on the Yoruba iro and buba with a satin top and brocade mini skirt. The mini skirt also gives the outfit a contemporary take on the Oleku silhouette, which traditionally pairs a loose or fitted buba with a wrapper tied above the knee. Alex’s version plays with that familiar proportion, using a fitted damask skirt in place of the wrapper. If you are wondering how to wear a buba and mini skirt without the proportions feeling off, the secret is balancing volume with structure. entertainment.title: What Are The Effective Ways of Using AI?
entertainment.description: Two people engaging with technology in a contemporary hotel lobby work setting. Artificial Intelligence (AI) is changing how people learn, work, communicate and solve problems. In today’s world, if you’re not on board with AI, it could be said you’re being resistant to the fastest-growing technological innovation in the world. From students researching academic subjects to professionals developing business ideas, AI tools have become companions in everyday activities for people. They can help save time, explore new ideas, understand difficult concepts and approach tasks differently. However, as more people embrace these AI tools, it is important to understand that using AI effectively goes beyond knowing what prompts to enter. It requires knowing when to use it, how to question its responses and, most importantly, when to rely on your own knowledge and judgement. AI could make us better at what we do, not make us dependent on it. Here are ways we think you use AI effectively: Use AI as a Research Assistant One of the most effective ways to use AI is for research and information gathering. Whether you are writing an article, preparing a presentation or exploring an unfamiliar subject, AI can help you identify relevant topics, explain complex ideas and suggest areas worth investigating. You can ask it to break down unfamiliar concepts, identify key questions, or suggest research directions. However, do not treat every response as fact. Verify important information using credible sources, published research, books and reliable websites. AI can help you find information, but you are responsible for establishing what is true. Use AI to Brainstorm and Explore Ideas Like knowledge gathering, AI can brainstorm ideas with you. Sometimes, the hardest part of starting a project is knowing where to begin. AI can help you overcome this challenge by suggesting ideas, exploring different approaches and presenting perspectives you may not have considered. For writers, entrepreneurs, researchers and creatives, it can be a useful brainstorming partner. You can share an idea, ask questions about its strengths and weaknesses, and explore ways to develop it. However, brainstorming should not become an excuse to surrender your imagination. Let AI expand your thinking, not replace it. Use AI to Improve Your Work, Not Replace Your Skills This is becoming more important. AI can help you identify grammatical errors, improve sentence construction, organise information, summarise lengthy documents and make your communication clearer. sports.title: Police investigation into Vigar's death ongoing
sports.description: Billy Vigar died from a "significant brain injury" in September 2025 [Getty Images] The police investigation into the death of former Arsenal academy player Billy Vigar is ongoing, a coroner's court has heard. Vigar died from a "significant brain injury" in September 2025, five days after colliding with a concrete wall surrounding a pitch while playing for Chichester City at Wingate and Finchley's stadium. His parents, Keith and Camilla, told BBC Sport on the one-year anniversary that "the FA could have stopped Billy losing his life because they had so many warnings". Det Supt Colin Chandler, from the Metropolitan Police, told a pre-inquest review hearing that he anticipated he would need another "two to three months" on his investigation. He did not provide details on the lines of enquiry that the police are exploring. BBC Sport has contacted the Met for comment. Vigar's parents were present for the hearing at Barnet Coroner's Court on Thursday, as were representatives from the Football Association and Barnet Council. Former Bath City player Alex Fletcher, who fractured his skull when colliding with concrete barriers next to the club's pitch in 2022, was also present, as was another representative from the PFA. Camilla Vigar told senior coroner Andrew Walker: "I don't understand how the FA waited for Billy to die before they actioned anything when there was so much warning beforehand. "Ben Hiscox dying in 2015. Alex had his big accident in 2022. The investigation they did after that highlighted about 160 high-risk clubs. Wingate was one of them. They did nothing." Keith Vigar spoke during the hearing to raise an "issue with Barnet not being an interested party" in the case. "Personally I don't quite understand how the investigation carried out at the football club, Wingate and Finchley... I see it as a bit of a conflict of interest that Barnet as the local authority carried out that investigation. It feels like they are marking their own homework," he said. A further hearing has been scheduled for 10 February.
